# PR #2961: Patch: card tests use the crate's scenario helper instead of registering the catalog before every scenario

Closes #2930

## What changed

Card tests now build every scenario through `crate::scenario`, which registers the shipped cards itself. The local copies of `ids`, `input` and `by` in the rules, cards and AI tests are replaced by one shared helper in each test tree's home. The diff touches 470 files: 3,096 lines removed and 1,153 added. Every test keeps its name and every assertion still checks the same thing. All card-script edits are below each file's `#[cfg(test)]`, and `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` prints `classify: Internal`, so no card plays differently and no patch fragment is needed.

- **Register lines:** the 2,240 `crate::register_all();` lines that sat directly above a `scenario(` call are gone, across 381 card scripts. 301 of those files now import `use crate::scenario;`. Every removed line was exactly `crate::register_all();`, and the next line always called `scenario(`, `crate::scenario(`, or a local `*_scenario` helper that calls `scenario(`.
- **Unused imports:** six modules used the testkit glob only for `scenario`, so their `use jackioh_engine::testkit::*;` line goes (it would otherwise fail `unused_imports`).
- **Shared helpers added:**
  - `harness.rs`: `ids` (generic over owned or borrowed cards), `input` and `by`.
  - `crates/cards/src/lib.rs`: `ids`, test-only.
  - `tests/cross/mod.rs` and `tests/ai/support.rs`: `ids` each.
- **Copies removed:** 62 rules files, 12 card scripts, `setup_and_mulligan.rs` and `determinize_sides.rs` now import the shared helper instead of defining their own.
  - `rotation.rs` calls `ids([…])` instead of `ids(&[…])` at its 11 call sites.
  - `clippy --fix` made 20 `needless_borrows_for_generic_args` fixes, all dropping a `&` before an `ids(…)` argument that is already a `Vec`.
- **Different bodies, renamed rather than shared:**
  - Rules tests:
    - `audit` → `def_ids`
    - `pools` → `ids_of_defs`
    - `scorer` → `scored_ids`
    - `effects_choose`, `play_choices`, `play_choices_filters` → `selection_ids`
    - `modifiers` → `effect_ids`
    - `input` → `player_input` in `kill_credit`, `instance_data`, `handicap`, `windfury`, and → `replay_input` in `replay_steps`
    - `by` → `run_by` in `rulings_a`
  - Card tests:
    - `ids` → `row_ids` in four card scripts
    - → `hand_ids`, `instance_ids` and `strings` in one script each
    - → `ids_of_defs` in four scripts and two cross tests
- **`crates/tools/tests/acceptance.rs`:**
  - `SHARED_TEST_HELPERS` now lists the new names, and has a new row with home `crates/cards/src/lib.rs` covering `crates/cards/src/scripts`.
  - A new scan, `registers_before_scenario`, has two tests: one runs it over the card scripts, the other checks the scan on its own sample.
- **`docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` §2:** the test template uses `use crate::scenario;`, the shared-helper list includes `ids`, and the text says the check now also refuses a register line above a `scenario(`.

| `cargo fmt --check` | clean |

- **Same test counts:** the plan counted rules 2471 on `488f90175`. Main has since added 6 tests in `hero_armor.rs`, so 2477 is the same set. The diff adds or removes no `#[test]` except the two new acceptance tests.
- **Each card test run in isolation:** I ran all 8,252 lib tests, each in its own process. Exactly 7 failed, the same 7 the plan lists (in `c051_1`, `c016` ×2, `c038`, `c046`, `c088` and `c089`). I didn't build base to rerun them. Instead I checked them directly: none of the seven calls `register_all` on base, and each panics reading the catalog before any scenario is built. So each only passes on base when another test has already registered the cards, and this change doesn't affect them.

## Decisions the issue left open

- **A new harness `ids` rather than switching to `ids_of`.** The check matches helpers by name, so it needs a home that defines `ids`. Also, `ids_of` takes only slices, and four of the copies took iterators. The existing uses of `ids_of` are unchanged.

- **`input` and `by` are refused only in the rules tests.** No card or AI test defines either name, and adding them to those homes would mean helpers nothing calls. A card or AI copy of `ids` is refused.
- **Helpers with different bodies are renamed, not exempted** (the issue's suggestion). The three identical `selection_ids` copies stay local, because the issue only moves `ids`, `input` and `by`.

- **CI scope:** the acceptance test now reads `crates/cards/src/scripts`, but `scripts/ci-scope.sh` already runs every Rust group, tools included, for any change to the cards, so the map needs no new line.
- **Out of scope:** the server, tools and run crates have their own `ids`, `input` and `by` with different shapes, and I left them alone.

# #2930: Patch: card tests use the crate's scenario helper instead of registering the catalog before every scenario
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

The card tests repeat the same setup line about 2,240 times: each test registers every card and then builds its scenario, although the cards crate already has a helper that does both. The rules tests also copy the same small helper functions into dozens of files.

Once this is built, those copies are gone. That is about 2,000 fewer lines of test code that behave exactly as before, so the files bots and people read are shorter, and the repository's existing check stops the copies from coming back.

## Why

- **The setup line is repeated about 2,240 times.**
  - `crates/cards/src/lib.rs:212-217` defines `pub(crate) fn scenario(opts)`, which runs `register_all()` and then the testkit's `scenario`.
  - Card scripts' tests still write `crate::register_all();` on the line directly before a `scenario(` call 2,240 times: `grep -A1 'register_all();' crates/cards/src/scripts | grep -c 'scenario('`.
  - In 53 files, 215 of those lines sit in modules that already import `crate::scenario`, so they register twice. For example, `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape/c021_moonberry.rs` lines 45, 67-68 and 78-79.
- **Rules tests copy the harness's helpers.**
  - `crates/engine/tests/rules/fixtures/harness.rs:140` has `ids_of`, yet 46 test files across the engine's rules tests, the cards and the AI each define their own `fn ids(cards: &[CardInstance]) -> Vec<String>`.
  - 28 rules files define their own `fn input(` and 18 their own `fn by(`.
- **The existing check cannot see them.** `crates/tools/tests/acceptance.rs:971` (`SHARED_TEST_HELPERS`) already refuses local copies of named harness helpers. It matches by name only and has no row for these.
- **Precedent.** #2759 cut comments and long names to reduce the token footprint; this cuts repeated code for the same reason.

## Proposal

1. In each card script's test module, add `use crate::scenario;` and drop the `crate::register_all();` that sits on the line before a `scenario(` call. A test that registers for any other reason keeps its call.
2. Move the most common form of `input` and `by` into `harness.rs`, switch the `ids` copies to `ids_of`, and delete the local copies.
3. Add the moved names to the harness row of `SHARED_TEST_HELPERS`. Add a check that no card script's test calls `register_all();` on the line before `scenario(`.
4. Change no assertion: every test keeps its name and what it checks.

## Where it lands

- `crates/cards/src/scripts/**` (test modules only), `crates/engine/tests/rules/**`, `crates/engine/tests/rules/fixtures/harness.rs`, and the AI tests that copy `ids`.
- `crates/tools/tests/acceptance.rs`.
- CLAUDE.md rule 6: each card's tests stay in its own file.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No card script calls `register_all();` on the line before a `scenario(` call, and the acceptance test fails on one.
- [ ] No rules, cards or AI test file defines its own copy of `ids`, `input` or `by`, and the acceptance test fails on one.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-cards` and `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test 'rules*'` run the same number of tests before and after.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo jackioh spec check` pass.

## Size and risks

Large by file count (several hundred card scripts and about 70 rules files) but mechanical; that makes it hard by CLAUDE.md rule 11's 40-file mark. The risk is merge conflicts with card pull requests in flight. It can land in a quiet window or be split by set. A test whose `by` or `input` differs from the common form keeps its local helper under its own name.
